scope: Compact SGA5 find-verify-fix workpass method snapshot distilled from the live SGA5 source-audit lane. This belongs on the workflow/replication record, not as a promoted SGA5 reader.
observed_contents: README explaining that this is workflow/methodology support rather than SGA5 certification.
sga5_audit_workflow.js, the later page-local find -> verify -> fix workflow driver, plus deterministic patch/render/chunk/index helpers.
SWARM_SESSION_STATUS_20260624.md and status/source-resolution notes recording the method evolution.
FINDINGS_consolidated_20260624.md and sga5_index.csv/json as compact workpass control examples.
Current CERT_LOG.md and AGENT_SCORECARD.md from the manual page-certification pass: pp.1-58 page-locally certified, p59 next; agents/workflows explicitly treated as finders, not certifiers.
FINDINGS_live.md and SGA5_AUDIT_METHOD_WRITEUP.md as live method/status companions; broad completion language is subordinate to CERT_LOG page-local certification.
workflow_lessons: Raw parallel swarms were useful for discovery but became server-rate-limit-bound and produced wasted agent runs when too many workflows ran concurrently.
The safer scalable pattern is one large workflow at a time: page-local discovery, independent verification, deterministic patch application, and a compile gate.
OCR and source crops are witness/localization layers only; source-page images and compiled TeX diffs remain the audit controls.
Support ZIPs can become stale within hours during an active workpass, so public records should label them as snapshots unless deliberately repackaged at a stable milestone.
Public archive labels must distinguish method/support packets, source-witnessed working drafts, source-audit candidates, and certified/critical editions.

The 2026-06-25 p1-p58 manual certification pass shows the core archive lesson: high-precision agent findings still miss repeated notation classes, source-typo traps, underlines, and parallel occurrences; public records must separate repair evidence from page-local certification.

The live post-snapshot hand pass advanced to pp.1-66 and strengthened the same lesson: agent precision can be high, but recall is incomplete across repeated twist signs, underlined Hom/Ext/H conventions, source-typo traps, and parallel references; page-local certification remains the controlling standard.
caveats: This package does not certify SGA5 and should not be attached to the SGA author record as a reader replacement.

The bundled workflow snapshot itself contains the earlier pp.1-58 CERT_LOG state; the live local workpass has since advanced to pp.1-66 with p67 next and should be captured in the next refreshed workflow package.

The associated SGA5 workpass remains incomplete/errorful globally, with English synchronization open and remaining page ranges requiring source comparison; only the current CERT_LOG page-local range should be treated as certified.
The package intentionally excludes bulky source crops, page renders, and the full workpass TeX/PDF.
next_action: Attach to the workflow/replication record during the next deliberate workflow DOI refresh, or rebuild first so the packaged CERT_LOG/AGENT_SCORECARD reflect the newer pp.1-66 live status.
